summary: Cannot confirm BADS private open space for every dwelling: condenser locations are not shown on the concept plans.

evidence.description: Concept floor plans show balcony outlines with some dimensions.
Dwelling mix lists Type B1 as two-bedroom, south-facing living.
Outdoor units are not marked on the concept set.

assumptions: Typology is apartment and Clause 58.05-3 applies.
No dwelling is above 40 m, so the living-room area substitution is not used.

checklistIssue.detail: The item says 'above about 40 m' without stating whether height is measured to the balcony floor or the top of the building.

suggestedChange.detail: Give every dwelling secluded private open space to the BADS table (area and minimum dimension). Add 1.5 m² if a condenser sits on the balcony. South-facing living balconies may be 1.2 m deep; north-facing may be 1.7 m. Where building height to the highest balcony serving a dwelling is more than 40 m, extra living-room area may substitute for balcony area per the BADS table.
